title: Conditional value-at-risk under reward-penalty mechanism with applications to robust portfolio management
abstract: arXiv:2610.09246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we present robust portfolio selection models by incorporating a reward and penalty mechanism into portfolio management. We assume that the joint distribution of the losses of the underlying risky assets in a portfolio is uncertain but lies within a multivariate distribution set. Our goal is to identify optimal portfolio allocations by minimizing the worst-case conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of portfolio loss under the reward and penalty mechanism and distribution uncertainty. Our models can also be used to investigate the problem of how to balance portfolio losses with their associated downside risk in portfolio management. We first derive an explicit closed-form expression for the worst-case CVaR under the reward-penalty mechanism, which generalizes several existing models and results regarding the worst-case CVaR, such as those studied in Jagannathan (1977), Chen et al. translated_title: 奖惩机制下的条件风险价值及其在鲁棒投资组合管理中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文通过将奖惩机制纳入投资组合管理，提出了鲁棒投资组合选择模型。我们假设投资组合中基础风险资产损失的联合分布是不确定的，但位于某一多元分布集合之内。我们的目标是在奖惩机制和分布不确定性下，通过最小化投资组合损失的最坏情况条件风险价值（CVaR）来确定最优的投资组合配置。我们的模型还可用于研究在投资组合管理中如何平衡投资组合损失与其相关的下行风险问题。我们首先推导出了奖惩机制下最坏情况CVaR的显式闭式表达式，该表达式推广了关于最坏情况CVaR的若干现有模型和结果，例如Jagannathan（1977）、Chen等人（2011）以及Cai等人（2024）所研究的结果。随后我们应用该……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在奖惩机制与分布不确定性下推导出最坏情况条件风险价值（CVaR）的显式闭式表达式，推广了已有相关模型与结果，并将其应用于鲁棒投资组合选择，以实现最优资产配置及投资组合损失与下行风险之间的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an explicit closed-form expression for the worst-case conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) under a reward-penalty mechanism and distributional uncertainty, generalizing several existing worst-case CVaR models, and applies it to robust portfolio selection for optimal asset allocation and balancing portfolio losses against downside risk.
